sections.lede: A.J. Hunter (Music Features Editor) opens this data card set by framing Sonic Fingerprint Card Set through music evidence from the 1978 RetroVerse dataset.
sections.analysis: Primary lens: music-first and era-aware. Beat alignment: music. Data focus: chart_dynamics, artist_power_index, sonic_profile.
sections.cultural_context: Context anchor: 1978-01-01 — January 1 – Air India Flight 855 , a Boeing 747 passenger jet, crashes off the coast of Bombay , killing 213.
